conceptZh: 玩具戰士打開禮物盒，蟲一隻一隻彈出來，嚇他一跳，又一起排成蟲字。
object: a chunky toy warrior and a surprise gift box
morph: three small caterpillar toys pop out and settle as 蟲
creativeAngle: 驚喜彈出：蟲蟲們從盒子彈出，連戰士都愣住。
promptEn: An 8-second animated clip on a pale leaf-green background, with one single Traditional Chinese glyph 蟲 as the only text on screen, drawn in bright magenta-pink solid strokes, centered, uncropped, about 70% of frame height with generous margins. 0-1.7s: a chunky toy warrior with a foam sword and round shield swaggers up to a polka-dot gift box and raps on it; the first 蟲 is spoken as the lid wobbles and the top 中 stroke pokes out. 1.7-3.4s: the lid bursts and three tiny stripe caterpillar toys spring out like jack-in-the-box; the warrior does a big double-take, shield flying; the second 蟲 is spoken as the caterpillars crawl into the lower 虫 strokes. 3.4-5s: 昆蟲 is spoken as a toy ladybug and a firefly buzz up out of the box one after the other. 5-8s: hold; the warrior bows his foam sword to the bugs, glyph still. Audio: a warm off-screen voice in clear Taiwanese Mandarin reads exactly "蟲、蟲、昆蟲" (ㄔㄨㄥˊ、ㄔㄨㄥˊ、ㄎㄨㄣ ㄔㄨㄥˊ), slowly and distinctly with clear tones, a short pause between the two single utterances, and stops after the word; no other speech, no subtitles, no vocabulary text. Final 3 seconds (5-8s): the glyph 蟲 is perfectly still and fully readable while the lead keeps a small joyful motion away from the strokes. Bright but not neon palette, no watermark, no flashing, no other writing.
